_comment: Overlay settings. Edit these values and relaunch the app — no bash env vars needed. An environment variable of the same name (e.g. VAD_SILENCE_MS) overrides the matching value here. Only finite positive numbers are used; a bad value falls back to the built-in default.

_help.silenceMs: Quiet (ms) after the interviewer stops talking before we treat it as end-of-question. Lower = snappier responses, but may clip slow/pausing speakers. Default 450.
_help.minSpeechMs: Ignore speech bursts shorter than this (ms) — filters out coughs/clicks. Default 350.
_help.maxUtterMs: Safety flush (ms) for a non-stop talker so a very long answer still gets processed. Default 15000.
_help.speechLevel: RMS audio level (0..1) above which we count the input as speech. Raise if background noise triggers false starts; lower if quiet speech is missed. Default 0.055.
